description: Continuous full-duplex echo reference, compatible immediate cloud-abort handling, reply-generation isolation and optional AEC-only playback headroom. Server VAD/ASR and stable motion/web/MCU stay unchanged.
hardware_echo_acceptance: Not passed: live cloud replies still appeared in ASR and user confirmed self-conversation. Bench echo-only reduction is not live acceptance.

aec_output_headroom_db.active_only: Real AEC plus an open and enabled capture stream. Combine with product volume/boost before PCM limiting. The final PCM remains the AEC render reference.

board_tuning_evidence.source: same 10-second local speech sample; no near-end speech requested
board_tuning_evidence.capture_gain_sweep_conclusion: Control readback changed, but strong clipping remained; no permanent capture-gain change selected.
board_tuning_evidence.limitations: One controlled placement and a speech sample; not a guarantee of all-room echo suppression, double-talk intelligibility or interruption latency.

accepted_output_baseline.user_report: Hardware-volume audition loud enough; remove additional speaker boost and attenuation.

prototype_only: capture level applied after stream startup
raw microphone level 25/50 percent with separate post-AEC gain
prototype_status: Not included in production code or the ZIP. Last comparison lost SSH/LAN connection; completion and temporary-state restoration must be checked on reconnect.
